full_details: The morning was the lodging. The left strap still wants shortening. The coffer is still the twenty pound fifteen shillings you ruled on the twenty-second, and you did not open it. The letter is still for tomorrow, after the bells. At two you played Egeon for the third time this week. After the play the sharers reckoned. It is the first Saturday share since July, and it is six-and-twenty shillings. Heminges named Monday at two as The Shrew. You put the share in your purse and left the coffer shut. You were in bed at nine.
one_sentence: You played Egeon, took six-and-twenty shillings at the first reckoning since July, and went to bed at nine.
title: Six-and-twenty, and bed at nine
